blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting, you need some simple English words.

Today the lesson is Fast and Slow Connection. You will learn five useful words: fast, slow, strong, weak and stable. You will use them in short, easy sentences.

Good IT habits protect the whole company. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow. Go step by step. You can do it!

items.q: What is the lesson about today?
items.why: "Today the lesson is Fast and Slow Connection."

items.q: How many new words will you learn?
items.why: "You will learn five useful words: fast, slow, strong, weak and stable."

items.q: When do you need these words?
options: When you talk to the help desk or join a meeting
items.why: "When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting, you need some simple English words."

items.q: The text says "Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow." This suggests that…
options: good habits now help you later
items.why: Inferência: pequenos hábitos hoje evitam problemas grandes depois.

items.q: "You can do it!" suggests that the lesson is…
items.why: Inferência: a frase encoraja o aluno — a lição é simples e possível.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James ajudar um colega numa videochamada lenta. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! This is James from IT. I can help you with your slow video call. Let's fix it together, step by step.

First, look at your screen. Is the connection fast or slow now? Okay, it is slow. That is fine. We can make it better.

Is the signal strong or weak? It looks weak. A weak signal makes the call slow and not clear. Please move close to the router. Good. Now the signal is more strong.

Is the call stable now, or does it stop and start? It stops sometimes. Let's try one thing. Please close the other programs. Now try again.

Better? Yes! The call is fast and stable now. The signal is strong. Great job!

Remember: if it is slow again, call the help desk. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow. Have a good meeting!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "This is James from IT."

items.q: How is the connection at the start?
items.why: "it is slow."

items.q: What does James ask the user to do to make the signal strong?
items.why: "Please move close to the router."

items.q: Why does James ask the user to close the other programs?
options: To make the call more stable
items.why: Inferência: os outros programas deixam a chamada instável; fechá-los ajuda a estabilizar.

items.q: How does James feel at the end?
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "Great job!" e "Have a good meeting!" — está contente e prestativo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The internet is very fast today." Fast means…
items.why: Fast = rápido.

items.q: "My video is slow, so I can't see you well." Slow means…
items.why: Slow = lento, não rápido.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The signal is ___, so the call is clear and fast."
items.why: Strong = forte; um sinal forte deixa a chamada clara.

items.q: "The signal is weak here." Weak means…
items.why: Weak = fraco, o contrário de forte.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The call does not stop now. It is ___."
items.why: Stable = estável; a chamada não para.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que você ouve quando fala com o suporte de IT. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you log in now?" To log in means to…
options: enter with your name and password
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com usuário e senha.

items.q: "Please restart your computer." To restart means to…
items.why: Restart = reiniciar, ligar de novo.

items.q: "I will call the help desk." This means you will…
options: write an email to a client
items.why: Call the help desk = ligar para o suporte de IT.

items.q: "Please hold on a moment." To hold on means to…
items.why: Hold on = espere um momento.

items.q: "Let's try again." This means…
items.why: Try again = tentar de novo, mais uma vez.
